{{Infobox auto}}

'''Charred meat''' is meat burnt in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]]. It heals {{Value|Charred Meat|heals}}, half as much as properly cooked meat, and has no other use.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/kiln/charred_meat.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Kilning ===
{{Recipes}}
Any raw meat (beef, chicken, porkchop, mutton or flesh) becomes charred meat in a mud kiln in {{Value|Charred Meat|cook_time}}. The recipe isn't added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating charred meat takes {{Value|Charred Meat|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Charred Meat|heals}} through Regeneration IV.
